findings.evidence: Row claims version_status=published with version=opt1-102. Per c2, published requires the maintainer to publish a release identifier that the version copies. SOURCE 1 shows the protocol page's task counts (102 tasks) and leaderboard metadata.total_tasks=102 (SOURCE 2), but no maintainer release/version identifier for the board anywhere in the packet. A page publishing no release identifier supports snapshot, not published; published is a mismatch when the page publishes none.
findings.repair: Change version_status to snapshot (version may remain the registry-written dated identity per c2 vocabulary) or supply packet evidence of a maintainer-published release identifier that opt1-102 copies.

uncertainties: Owner-computed row SHA-256 (26dbde96...) and artifact SHA-256 cannot be independently recomputed in this read-only review; binding accepted as given.
Transport/qualification checks (producer receipt) are executed separately by the owner and were not re-verified here.

SOURCE 1 leaderboard content is served via client-side loading ('Loading leaderboard...'); SOURCE 2 JSON is treated as the served payload per packet, which is consistent with c1's value-scale summary (32 values, 0 to 88.24) matching the JSON's 32 score values.
Row's scoring.notes omit the 2026-09-27 changelog entry; c1 does not require notes to enumerate all changelog entries, so not a finding.
